title: Crop Harvest MC
description: Harvest crops with right click and automatically replant them using seeds from your inventory.
body:

Crop Harvest is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly quality-of-life mod for Fabric focused on maximum compatibility with other mods.

It improves farming by allowing you to harvest fully grown crops with right click while keeping the vanilla balance intact.
If you have the required seeds in your inventory, the crop will be automatically replanted.

The mod is designed to work safely alongside other gameplay, farming, and content mods without conflicts.

🌱 How it works

Right-click a fully grown crop

The crop drops its harvest

1 seed is consumed from your inventory

The crop is replanted automatically

If you don’t have seeds, the crop will not be replanted.

🌾 Supported Crops

Wheat

Carrots

Potatoes

Beetroots

Nether Wart

(Additional crops may work depending on mod compatibility)

⚖️ Balance & Compatibility

Requires seeds in inventory (no free replanting)

No automation or redstone interaction

No new items or blocks

No changes to world generation

Designed to avoid conflicts with other mods

Safe to use in existing worlds

This makes Crop Harvest ideal for large modpacks, long-term Survival, and Hardcore worlds.

🛠 Features

Right-click harvesting

Automatic replanting using inventory seeds

High compatibility with other mods

Works in Survival and Hardcore

Multiplayer-safe

Lightweight and performance-friendly
